findings.summary: SpeedRunner's current public allow_replay switch is not a candidate-frozen admission-only intervention: replay mode changes the induction system prompt, requires a scripted test trajectory, exposes an additional submit_test_trajectory tool, and then applies replay-based commit/revert; no-replay mode omits that proposal contract and commits statically-valid proposals immediately.

The strongest safe interpretation of SpeedRunner Figure-12-style replay evidence remains system/component-level verification evidence, not same-candidate adopt-vs-reject causality, unless historical artifacts bind identical candidate bytes/proposal state across replay and no-replay arms.

MemCompiler's initial public ScienceWorld runner uses ./output/memcompiler while the same revision ignores *.db, output*/, .db*/, logs and zip files; ordinary Git history therefore cannot be expected to contain the persisted evaluated memory DB snapshot.

MemCompiler Table-3 memory provenance search should move from repository-history repetition to external public artifacts or a run manifest; the absence of a DB in Git is not evidence that no evaluated DB existed, and post-paper public defaults cannot be back-projected into the historical run.

protocol_change_rationale: No new validator was added: existing transactional-skill-admission, evaluated-run-source binding, replay-export provenance, memory-snapshot binding and fixed-selected-identity receiver-effect protocols already express the newly observed boundaries. The value this run is causal-scope correction and search-space pruning, not another redundant schema.

scope_guard.speedrunner: Do not interpret current allow_replay=true vs false as holding candidate skill bytes or proposal distribution fixed. Do not assign Figure 12 exact numeric values without a raw artifact.
scope_guard.memcompiler: Do not infer nonexistence of an evaluated memory DB from Git exclusion. Do not attribute initial/current public defaults to Table 3 without a historical run bridge.

phase1_acceptance_assessment.hidden_executor_absence: The audit and durable evidence packaging used scheduled-Chat-accessible public repository reads plus lightweight repository state writes only; no hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact build, package execution or manual-user execution was used as an accepted outcome step.

blockers: The historical SpeedRunner ScienceWorld Task-3 Figure-12 raw numeric bundle, exact candidate skill bytes, replay inputs, environment/seed identity and commit/revert records were not found in the observed public Git/release surfaces.

The MemCompiler Table-3 evaluated ScienceWorld memory DB/candidate-pool snapshot and source/run manifest remain unbound; ordinary Git history is structurally the wrong search surface for ignored persisted DB/output artifacts.
